sandbachFocus: Sandbach United suffered a disappointing 1-3 defeat to New Mills on Tuesday evening at Hind Heath Road. Despite an early equalizer (possibly an own goal), the Bach conceded twice more in the second half, including an awkward bounce that caught their defence out. The loss leaves them with 6 points from 4 games after their earlier 1-0 victory over Stafford Town on Saturday.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals' perfect record ended dramatically as they lost 1-2 at home to Eccleshall on Wednesday night—Max Chimenes and Morgan Russell scored for the visitors despite Kieran Cook's 55th-minute equalizer, and Eccleshall finished with 10 men after a red card. Stafford Town bounced back from their Sandbach loss with an impressive 3-2 away win at Alsager Town, with Sam Lynch, Patryk Mazurkiewicz, and Eshan Greer on target despite going down to 10 men early in the second half. Market Drayton Town claimed a 1-0 local derby victory over Telford Town thanks to Cian McIntosh's 74th-minute goal. Shawbury United won an entertaining 4-3 away encounter at Allscott Heath, with Ethan Pickford scoring twice. Foley Meir secured a 3-0 win at Crewe with goals from Fin Foote and Freddie Lloyd (twice). AFC Bridgnorth drew 1-1 at Wednesfield Community, while Wednesfield drew 1-1 with Bridgnorth, earning a point against an in-form side. Crewe's home record worsened with the loss to Foley, continuing their struggles. Notable squad activity included Eccleshall signing Dylan Bath from Market Drayton, and Market Drayton Town adding striker Josh Oultram on dual registration from Vauxhall Motors.
